mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(A.PROD_ID)) FROM objRec A INNER JOIN CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB_SUM B ON A.PROD_ID = B.PRODID WHERE STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(B.HOLD_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d'), '%Y-%m-%d') = STR_TO_DATE(#{searchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT prdRegistCode, prodId, prdVDate, holdDate, prdRaiseTotalQty, prdRaiseTotalAmt, investRaiseTotalQty, investRaiseTotalAmt FROM( SELECT tmp1.REG_CODE prdRegistCode, tmp1.PROD_ID as prodId, tmp1.VDATE prdVDate, STR_TO_DATE(#{searchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') AS holdDate, IFNULL(tmp1.RAISE_QTY,0) as prdRaiseTotalQty, IFNULL(tmp1.TOTAL_AMT,0) as prdRaiseTotalAmt, SUM(IFNULL(QTY,0)) as investRaiseTotalQty, SUM(IFNULL(CNY_AMT,0)) as investRaiseTotalAmt FROM( SELECT A.PROD_ID, A.VDATE, A.RAISE_QTY, A.TOTAL_AMT, B.CNY_AMT CNY_AMT, B.QTY QTY, D.REG_CODE FROM objRec A LEFT JOIN CHB_PRDRESIST_CODE D ON A.PROD_ID = D.PRODID INNER JOIN CHB_INVESTHOLD_INFO_SUB_SUM B ON A.PROD_ID = B.PRODID WHERE STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(B.HOLD_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d'), '%Y-%m-%d') = STR_TO_DATE(#{searchDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d') ) tmp1 GROUP BY tmp1.PROD_ID, tmp1.REG_CODE, tmp1.VDATE, tmp1.RAISE_QTY, tmp1.TOTAL_AMT ) tmp2 WHERE investRaiseTotalQty > 0 AND investRaiseTotalAmt > 0
